data_contracts_summary.pipeline_watermarks: layer TEXT, table_name TEXT, last_ym TEXT CHECK regex, row_count BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, PK(layer, table_name)
data_contracts_summary.fact_trajectory_enriched: ADD ym TEXT NOT NULL, backfill via to_char(to_timestamp(time), 'YYYY-MM'), idx_fact_traj_ym
data_contracts_summary.pipeline_runs: ADD ym TEXT NOT NULL, backfill from run_date, dedup existing duplicates, UNIQUE (ym, source, method, noise)
data_contracts_summary.sink_pattern: COPY to TEMP TABLE; INSERT ... SELECT DISTINCT ON (pk) ... ON CONFLICT (...) DO UPDATE SET ... COALESCE on nullable columns; watermark upsert in same txn
data_contracts_summary.pipeline_runs_pattern: WITH new_run AS (INSERT ... DO NOTHING RETURNING run_id) SELECT run_id FROM new_run - orphans eval_results prevented via caller gate on row is None
data_contracts_summary.partition_writer: pq.write_table per ym group to ym=YYYY-MM/part.parquet (NOT write_to_dataset which drops partition cols and uses UUID basenames under pyarrow 24)
